baseline_models.focus_anchor: The frame 'to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth' closes with 'Allah is knowing of every thing.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposite vertical poles enclose the inhabited domain; the repeated divine name frames that domain, while 'all' and 'thing' remove residual exceptions. Ownership and knowledge therefore coincide in scope.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped-and-worship image identifies the claimant at both ends of the focus and makes belonging answerable rather than merely spatial.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the owned domain.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary pole, closing the spatial span.
Disclosure to the knower joins present awareness to the final all-encompassing predicate.
The image of encompassing all parts closes every gap in the knowledge claim.
A thing as whatever can be known and reported makes each particular eligible for the closing knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: A cosmic possession statement followed by a general assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: Every occupant and every reportable particular lies inside one owned and already known domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'He knows what you are upon' then 'the day they are returned to Him, He informs them of what they did.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Present condition is already disclosed to the knower; a bounded decisive day brings a passive return, after which an arriving report confronts each person with intentional action. The report reveals rather than supplies divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure to the knower establishes that the current stance is already open before the return.
The image of a momentous occurrence gives the disclosure a decisive temporal horizon.
Return or restoration supplies the movement back to the focus's divine endpoint.
An arriving, consequential report makes the known record confront the returned subjects.
Intentional action fixes the report's object as enacted conduct rather than an unformed inner possibility.

changed_reading.before: People will eventually be reminded of their deeds.
changed_reading.after: An already-known present stance advances to compelled return and personal disclosure of its intentional record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by making norms visible signs and disclosed meanings, then repeats that pairing. Against that sequence, the final informing reads as the terminal exposure of conduct made distinguishable by those signs.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as a distinguishing mark supplies the focus-side capacity for conduct to be traced.
A visibly manifest sign supplies public criteria by which conduct becomes distinguishable.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign makes those criteria intelligible rather than merely visible.
The consequential report gathers the marked conduct into a final intelligible disclosure.

structural_cues: The sign-and-clarification pairing recurs at 24:18, 24:34, 24:46, 24:58-59, and 24:61 before the closing report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, clarified meaning, and knowledge as a mark; I infer that norms make later conduct evidentially legible. A live alternative is that the final knowledge remains purely divine cognition, without this pedagogical trace function.

changed_reading.before: The closing report discloses deeds known independently of the surah's instruction.
changed_reading.after: The closing report culminates a process in which clarified signs have made each response distinguishable and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first demands witnessed proof, then follows falsehood as it is inverted and relayed by knowledge-deficient tongues. On the decisive day, the tongue itself becomes an informed witness to action and truth stands fixed. The divine report thus reverses corrupted human reporting through an embodied evidentiary record.

activation_trace.role: The consequential report is the focus anchor whose authority is sharpened by the surah's failed human reports.
Testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge establishes the surah's evidentiary standard.
Falsehood turned away from truth supplies the distortion that the final report must undo.
The speech organ carries the ungrounded report, locating distortion in embodied transmission.
The explicit absence of knowledge diagnoses why the circulating human report fails.
Informed declaration returns as testimony, now generated by the subject's own organs.
The same speech organ is reassigned from rumor-carrier to witness.
Intentional deeds are exactly the object of bodily testimony and of the focus's final report.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the settled result of the evidentiary reversal.

structural_cues: 24:15's 'what you have no knowledge of' contrasts with the repeated divine knowledge in 24:64.
24:24 repeats both the decisive day and the formula 'what they used to do' immediately before truth is made manifest in 24:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inverted falsehood, tongues transmitting without knowledge, and later bodily testimony; I infer that the final informing restores truth through a self-attesting record. A live alternative is a direct divine declaration with no implied evidentiary process.

changed_reading.before: God tells people what they did.
changed_reading.after: The authoritative final report repairs a world of inverted and ungrounded speech by confronting each person with embodied testimony to the actual deed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Homes create real inside-outside boundaries and entry is permission-gated, yet the manifest and concealed remain equally known to God. The heavens-earth totality therefore reaches into domestic and inward zones without converting divine access into human entitlement.

activation_trace.role: The overarching upper realm supplies one boundary of the total domain within which every smaller enclosure sits.
The lower inhabited realm places domestic interiors inside, not outside, the focus's scope.
Entry into an interior supplies the human crossing that requires regulation.
Shelter and dwelling supply a materially bounded private zone.
Permission makes human access conditional and preserves the enclosure's ethical force.
Divine knowledge explicitly spans both sides of the following concealment contrast.
Emergence into visibility supplies the public side of conduct.
Concealment and covering supply the private or inward side that remains known.
Repeated knowledge closes public, private, current, and eventual conduct into one audit.

structural_cues: 24:27-31 repeatedly regulate entry, gaze, appearance, and concealment rather than treating privacy as unreal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real human boundaries plus divine knowledge of manifest and concealed conduct; I infer that cosmic ownership contains every enclosure while leaving human permission rules intact. A live alternative is that 24:64 remains cosmic in scale and does not reactivate the domestic sequence.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth name an abstract cosmic totality.
changed_reading.after: The totality includes every ethically protected interior and concealed act, even though no human gains license to cross those boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same heavens-earth span is illuminated and guiding at 24:35, populated by creatures practicing praise and prayer at 24:41, and named as sovereignty moving toward an outcome at 24:42. The close condenses these into an audit of where humans stand within an ordered, worshipping domain.

activation_trace.role: The overarching sky supplies the upper half of the domain repeated across the activating sequence.
The earth supplies the lower half of that same illuminated, active, and governed domain.
Illumination makes the heavens-earth domain a field of disclosure rather than inert property.
Gentle direction toward a path gives the illuminated domain an orienting force.
Praise and worship make the domain actively responsive to its owner.
Specified worship gives each creature an enacted orientation within the cosmic order.
Sovereignty turns the focus's belonging formula into governed dominion.
Becoming toward an outcome anticipates the focus's return to the same owner.
Return realizes the destination already attached to cosmic sovereignty.

structural_cues: 24:35 and 24:64 share the heavens-earth span and the exact all-things knowledge closure.
24:41 and 24:64 share the heavens-earth span, 'all,' divine knowledge, and the acts of the domain's inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, guidance, creaturely worship, sovereignty, and destination around repeated focus language; I infer that 'what you are upon' measures alignment within that order. A live alternative is simple formulaic recapitulation without an alignment claim.

changed_reading.before: God owns the cosmos and knows the human condition.
changed_reading.after: Humans are audited for their orientation inside an illuminated, worshipping, governed cosmos already moving toward its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action is met by corresponding recompense, while mirage-like works end in a fully paid account. The focus's return-report sequence can therefore carry more than information: deeds arrive as a completed reckoning whose outcome answers their character.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the movement into the settlement scene.
The consequential report makes the account personally intelligible.
Intentional action is the common object of report and recompense.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal arrow from deed to outcome.
The rewarded object is the same intentional action named in the focus.
Mirage-like works supply the contrasting case in which apparent yield collapses at settlement.
Counting and account turn the deed-outcome relation into a reckoning rather than a bare recollection.
Full completion without deficiency makes the reckoning exact and settled.

structural_cues: 24:38-39 place accepted and mirage-like works in parallel outcome scenes before 24:64 again names what people did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corresponding recompense and a fully completed account; I infer that the final informing participates in settlement, not only recollection. A live alternative is that notification and recompense are adjacent but distinct acts.

changed_reading.before: The returned subjects receive information about past deeds.
changed_reading.after: They confront deeds as an exact account whose returned outcome answers what those deeds actually were.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed obedience can turn into withdrawal; true believers remain upon a gathering affair until permission, while others slip out by hiding behind one another. The immediately repeated 'He certainly knows' makes 'what you are upon' a positional audit of enacted allegiance, including covert exit.

activation_trace.role: Repeated divine knowledge anchors the focus's audit of the addressees' present position.
Professed obedience supplies one claimed stance toward the summons.
Turning away supplies enacted withdrawal that contradicts the claimed stance.
Affair or present concern supplies the concrete object on which the group is jointly positioned.
Gathering dispersed persons into one whole gives that affair its communal geometry.
The immediately preceding knowledge formula targets those whose movement is designed to escape notice.
Slipping out supplies covert physical disengagement from the shared affair.
Hiding behind another supplies the social technique used to mask that disengagement.
Binding command identifies the authority from which covert withdrawal departs.

structural_cues: 24:62 places believers 'upon a gathering affair,' closely anticipating 24:64's 'what you are upon.'
24:63 and 24:64 repeat 'qad ya'lamu' across the boundary between covert departure and the closing audit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an 'upon' shared affair, permission-governed departure, covert slipping, and repeated knowledge; I infer that the focus audits allegiance through bodily position and movement. A live alternative is that 'what you are upon' remains a general condition with no special communal reference.

changed_reading.after: God knows whether a person is truly situated within the shared command or only claims obedience while turning or slipping away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates road and marker branches behind ordinary words for knowing, informing, and working. It remains anchored in the focus's 'upon,' return, report, and deeds, while the packet explicitly supplies followed footsteps, an extended way, a straight road, and covert departure. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial-material analogy, not as a lexical replacement or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The linked focus branches make knowledge a waymark, informing a clear road, work a traversed road, and return a retracing movement.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing waymark makes the traveled course readable.
A clear road gives the final report a route-revealing image.
A road made passable by use lets repeated acts materialize as a traversed track.
Return supplies the backward movement from which the completed track can be surveyed.
Followed footprints supply the incremental formation of a behavioral route.
An extended traversable way supplies the legitimate route against which footsteps can be compared.
The straight road sharpens the route into an orienting norm.
Slipping out supplies the final deviant movement immediately before the route is audited.

changed_reading.before: Deeds form an itemized record that will be verbally reported.
changed_reading.after: Deeds form a walked track: its steps, deviations, and waymarks make the person's actual course visible when the traveler is returned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a domestic entry rule as a miniature analogue of ultimate return. It remains anchored through the exact return root in 24:28 and 24:64, with entry, permission, action, and knowledge in the same local sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ethical rehearsal of accepting limits, not identify the two returns or derive eschatology from house etiquette.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive ultimate return in 24:64 reactivates the commanded return from a threshold in 24:28.

activation_trace.role: Return to an originating direction anchors the final compelled movement.
Entry into an interior creates the threshold at which willingness is tested.
Permission makes crossing depend on acknowledged authority rather than desire alone.
The doubled command to return supplies a voluntary, present-scale enactment of accepting a limit.
Intentional compliance at the threshold enters the deed record named in the focus.
Divine knowledge immediately audits whether the commanded return was enacted.

changed_reading.before: Ultimate return is detached from the surah's ordinary social movements.
changed_reading.after: Every accepted threshold rehearses a willing return under authority before the day on which return is no longer optional.

strongest_changes: The evidence sequence turns the final informing into an authoritative repair of false, knowledge-deficient human reporting through embodied witness.
The domestic sequence places protected interiors and concealed acts inside divine scope without erasing human permission boundaries.
The light, worship, sovereignty, and destination sequence turns cosmic ownership into an audit of alignment within an active ordered domain.
The immediate 24:62-63 sequence gives 'what you are upon' positional force: remaining with, turning from, or covertly leaving a shared command.
summary.what_was_special: The close recombines formulas distributed across the surah, but the immediate repetition of 'qad ya'lamu' after covert withdrawal most sharply changes the focus. The branch inventories also preserve a live track-reading in which deeds become the route and marks by which a life is disclosed.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether the final informing itself performs settlement or precedes a distinct recompense.
The alignment reading may be a deliberate recapitulation of 24:35-42 or only a strong thematic echo.
The traversed-track and boundary-rehearsal readings are controlled analogies, not lexical translations.
